questions.stem: Why would a trained athlete recover from oxygen debt faster than an untrained person?

options.text: Trained athletes do not produce lactic acid
Trained athletes have a more efficient cardiovascular system that delivers oxygen faster
Trained athletes have larger lungs that store more oxygen
Trained athletes do not use anaerobic respiration

questions.explanation: Trained athletes have a stronger heart, more capillaries in muscles, and more efficient gas exchange. This allows them to deliver oxygen to muscles faster and remove lactic acid more quickly during recovery.
